quality.policy: a stale/floor-qualified reference day is labelled raw_reference_only and kept; the label never removes an object and never enters a distance

rare.policy: a unique/giant-tail object stays a catalogue row with its own day/clock interval/scale/raw-lane sha and population digest; it is never removed for being far away, outside a radius or neighbourless
